# tag: coding.swift.stdlib
what does append do on a swift array | swift array append | how do i use append with a array in swift | array append swift => In Swift, `array.append(x)` adds x to the end of a `var` array. Use `append(contentsOf:)` to add a whole other array.
what does insert do on a swift array | swift array insert | how do i use insert with a array in swift | array insert swift => In Swift, `array.insert(x, at: 0)` puts x at that index and shifts the rest along.
what does remove last do on a swift array | swift array remove last | how do i use remove last with a array in swift | array remove last swift => In Swift, `array.removeLast()` removes and returns the last element; it crashes on an empty array. `popLast()` returns nil instead.
what does remove all do on a swift array | swift array remove all | how do i use remove all with a array in swift | array remove all swift => In Swift, `array.removeAll()` empties the array. `removeAll(where:)` removes only items matching a condition, like `removeAll { $0 < 0 }`.
what does count do on a swift array | swift array count | how do i use count with a array in swift | array count swift => In Swift, `array.count` is the number of elements.
what does first do on a swift array | swift array first | how do i use first with a array in swift | array first swift => In Swift, `array.first` is the first element as an optional, nil if the array is empty. `array.last` is the last.
what does contains do on a swift array | swift array contains | how do i use contains with a array in swift | array contains swift => In Swift, `array.contains(x)` returns true if x is in the array. `contains(where:)` checks with a condition.
what does first index do on a swift array | swift array first index | how do i use first index with a array in swift | array first index swift => In Swift, `array.firstIndex(of: x)` returns the index of the first x as an optional, or nil if it is not there.
what does reversed do on a swift array | swift array reversed | how do i use reversed with a array in swift | array reversed swift => In Swift, `array.reversed()` gives the elements in reverse order. Wrap it in `Array(...)` if you need a real array.
what does map do on a swift array | swift array map | how do i use map with a array in swift | array map swift => In Swift, `array.map { $0 * 2 }` returns a new array made by changing every element with the closure.
what does filter do on a swift array | swift array filter | how do i use filter with a array in swift | array filter swift => In Swift, `array.filter { $0 > 10 }` returns a new array with only the elements for which the closure returns true.
what does reduce do on a swift array | swift array reduce | how do i use reduce with a array in swift | array reduce swift => In Swift, `array.reduce(0, +)` combines all elements into one value, here their sum. The first argument is the starting value.
what does compact map do on a swift array | swift array compact map | how do i use compact map with a array in swift | array compact map swift => In Swift, `array.compactMap { Int($0) }` transforms each element and drops any nil results, handy for converting strings to numbers.
what does flat map do on a swift array | swift array flat map | how do i use flat map with a array in swift | array flat map swift => In Swift, `array.flatMap { $0 }` turns an array of arrays into one flat array.
what does for each do on a swift array | swift array for each | how do i use for each with a array in swift | array for each swift => In Swift, `array.forEach { print($0) }` runs the closure for each element. A plain for-in loop does the same and can use break.
what does enumerated do on a swift array | swift array enumerated | how do i use enumerated with a array in swift | array enumerated swift => In Swift, `for (index, item) in array.enumerated()` gives each element with its position, starting at 0.
what does shuffled do on a swift array | swift array shuffled | how do i use shuffled with a array in swift | array shuffled swift => In Swift, `array.shuffled()` returns the elements in a random order; `shuffle()` shuffles a var array in place.
what does random element do on a swift array | swift array random element | how do i use random element with a array in swift | array random element swift => In Swift, `array.randomElement()` returns a random element as an optional, nil if the array is empty.
what does min do on a swift array | swift array min | how do i use min with a array in swift | array min swift => In Swift, `array.min()` and `array.max()` return the smallest and largest elements as optionals.
what does joined do on a swift array | swift array joined | how do i use joined with a array in swift | array joined swift => In Swift, `["a", "b"].joined(separator: ", ")` joins an array of strings into one string.
what does indices do on a swift array | swift array indices | how do i use indices with a array in swift | array indices swift => In Swift, `array.indices` is the range of valid indexes, so `for i in array.indices` loops safely.
what does swap at do on a swift array | swift array swap at | how do i use swap at with a array in swift | array swap at swift => In Swift, `array.swapAt(i, j)` swaps the elements at two indexes.
what does prefix do on a swift array | swift array prefix | how do i use prefix with a array in swift | array prefix swift => In Swift, `array.prefix(3)` gives the first 3 elements, and `suffix(3)` the last 3, without crashing if there are fewer.
what does all satisfy do on a swift array | swift array all satisfy | how do i use all satisfy with a array in swift | array all satisfy swift => In Swift, `array.allSatisfy { $0 > 0 }` returns true if every element passes the test.
what does zip do on a swift array | swift array zip | how do i use zip with a array in swift | array zip swift => In Swift, `zip(names, scores)` pairs up two sequences element by element, so you can loop `for (name, score) in zip(names, scores)`.
what does is empty do on a swift string | swift string is empty | how do i use is empty with a string in swift | string is empty swift => In Swift, `text.isEmpty` is true for an empty string "".
what does uppercased do on a swift string | swift string uppercased | how do i use uppercased with a string in swift | string uppercased swift => In Swift, `text.uppercased()` returns a copy in capitals, and `lowercased()` in small letters.
what does has prefix do on a swift string | swift string has prefix | how do i use has prefix with a string in swift | string has prefix swift => In Swift, `text.hasPrefix("Mr")` returns true if the string starts with that text, and `hasSuffix` checks the end.
what does replacing occurrences do on a swift string | swift string replacing occurrences | how do i use replacing occurrences with a string in swift | string replacing occurrences swift => In Swift, `text.replacingOccurrences(of: "a", with: "b")` returns a copy with every match replaced. It comes from Foundation, so `import Foundation`.
what does trimming characters do on a swift string | swift string trimming characters | how do i use trimming characters with a string in swift | string trimming characters swift => In Swift, `text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)` removes spaces and newlines from both ends (Foundation).
what does components do on a swift string | swift string components | how do i use components with a string in swift | string components swift => In Swift, `text.components(separatedBy: ",")` splits a string into an array of Strings (Foundation).
what does reversed do on a swift string | swift string reversed | how do i use reversed with a string in swift | string reversed swift => In Swift, `String(text.reversed())` makes a reversed copy of a string.
what does append do on a swift string | swift string append | how do i use append with a string in swift | string append swift => In Swift, `text.append("!")` adds to the end of a var string, the same as `text += "!"`.
what does first do on a swift string | swift string first | how do i use first with a string in swift | string first swift => In Swift, `text.first` is the first Character as an optional. Swift strings cannot be indexed with plain numbers like `text[0]`.
what does character do on a swift string | swift string character | how do i use character with a string in swift | string character swift => A `Character` is one visible character, like "a" or an emoji. Looping `for ch in text` gives Characters.
what does subscript do on a swift dictionary | swift dictionary subscript | how do i use subscript with a dictionary in swift | dictionary subscript swift => In Swift, `dict["key"]` returns an optional value, nil if the key is missing. `dict["key"] = value` adds or changes, and `= nil` removes it.
what does keys do on a swift dictionary | swift dictionary keys | how do i use keys with a dictionary in swift | dictionary keys swift => In Swift, `dict.keys` and `dict.values` give the keys and values. Dictionaries have no fixed order, so sort them if order matters.
what does remove value do on a swift dictionary | swift dictionary remove value | how do i use remove value with a dictionary in swift | dictionary remove value swift => In Swift, `dict.removeValue(forKey: "key")` removes the entry and returns the old value as an optional.
what does update value do on a swift dictionary | swift dictionary update value | how do i use update value with a dictionary in swift | dictionary update value swift => In Swift, `dict.updateValue(v, forKey: k)` sets a value and returns the old one, or nil if the key was new.
what does for loop do on a swift dictionary | swift dictionary for loop | how do i use for loop with a dictionary in swift | dictionary for loop swift => In Swift, `for (key, value) in dict` loops over every entry, in no particular order.
what does map values do on a swift dictionary | swift dictionary map values | how do i use map values with a dictionary in swift | dictionary map values swift => In Swift, `dict.mapValues { $0 * 2 }` makes a new dictionary with the same keys and changed values.
what does count do on a swift dictionary | swift dictionary count | how do i use count with a dictionary in swift | dictionary count swift => In Swift, `dict.count` is how many key-value pairs it has, and `isEmpty` tells if there are none.
what does insert do on a swift set | swift set insert | how do i use insert with a set in swift | set insert swift => In Swift, `set.insert(x)` adds x if it is not already there, and returns whether it was inserted.
what does contains do on a swift set | swift set contains | how do i use contains with a set in swift | set contains swift => In Swift, `set.contains(x)` checks if x is in the set, very quickly.
what does union do on a swift set | swift set union | how do i use union with a set in swift | set union swift => In Swift, `a.union(b)` returns everything in either set, `a.intersection(b)` what is in both, and `a.subtracting(b)` what is only in a.
what does remove do on a swift set | swift set remove | how do i use remove with a set in swift | set remove swift => In Swift, `set.remove(x)` removes x and returns it as an optional.
what does guard let do on a swift optional | swift optional guard let | how do i use guard let with a optional in swift | optional guard let swift => In Swift, `guard let user = user else { return }` exits early when the value is nil, and keeps it unwrapped for the rest of the function.
what does nil coalescing do on a swift optional | swift optional nil coalescing | how do i use nil coalescing with a optional in swift | optional nil coalescing swift => In Swift, `name ?? "Guest"` uses the optional's value, or "Guest" if it is nil.
what does force unwrap do on a swift optional | swift optional force unwrap | how do i use force unwrap with a optional in swift | optional force unwrap swift => In Swift, `value!` force unwraps an optional and crashes if it is nil. Avoid it unless you are sure a value exists.
what does implicitly unwrapped optional do on a swift optional | swift optional implicitly unwrapped optional | how do i use implicitly unwrapped optional with a optional in swift | optional implicitly unwrapped optional swift => A type like `String!` is an implicitly unwrapped optional: it can be nil but unwraps itself when used, crashing if nil. Use it rarely.
how do i use print in swift | print in swift explained => In Swift, `print("Hi", score)` writes values to the console, separated by spaces. In Xcode it shows in the debug area.
what does min do in swift | swift min | how do i use min in swift | min in swift explained => In Swift, `min(a, b)` returns the smaller value and `max(a, b)` the larger. They take more than two arguments too.
what does abs do in swift | swift abs | how do i use abs in swift | abs in swift explained => In Swift, `abs(-5)` returns 5, the absolute value.
how do i use stride in swift | stride in swift explained => In Swift, `stride(from: 0, to: 10, by: 2)` counts 0, 2, 4, 6, 8. Use `through:` instead of `to:` to include the end.
what does random do in swift | swift random | how do i use random in swift | random in swift explained => In Swift, `Int.random(in: 1...6)` gives a random whole number from 1 to 6. `Double.random(in: 0..<1)` and `Bool.random()` work too.
what does round do in swift | swift round | how do i use round in swift | round in swift explained => In Swift, `x.rounded()` rounds a Double to the nearest whole number; `.rounded(.down)` and `.rounded(.up)` force a direction.
what does square root do in swift | swift square root | how do i use square root in swift | square root in swift explained => In Swift, `x.squareRoot()` returns the square root of a Double. `sqrt(x)` works too after `import Foundation`.
what does pow do in swift | swift pow | how do i use pow in swift | pow in swift explained => In Swift, `pow(2.0, 3.0)` returns 8.0. It needs `import Foundation`.
what does is multiple do in swift | swift is multiple | how do i use is multiple in swift | is multiple in swift explained => In Swift, `n.isMultiple(of: 2)` returns true for even numbers. It is clearer than `n % 2 == 0`.
what does range do in swift | swift range | how do i use range in swift | range in swift explained => In Swift, `1...5` is a closed range including 5, and `1..<5` is a half-open range that stops before 5.
what does type do in swift | swift type | how do i use type in swift | type in swift explained => In Swift, `type(of: x)` tells you the type of a value at run time, like `Int` or `String`.
how do i use assert in swift | assert in swift explained => In Swift, `assert(score >= 0, "negative score")` stops a debug build if the condition is false. `precondition` also checks in release builds.
what does fatal error do in swift | swift fatal error | how do i use fatal error in swift | fatal error in swift explained => In Swift, `fatalError("message")` stops the app on purpose with a message, for situations that should never happen.
how do i use defer in swift | defer in swift explained => In Swift, `defer { }` runs its block when the surrounding scope ends, however it exits, which is handy for cleanup.
how do i use typealias in swift | typealias in swift explained => In Swift, `typealias Score = Int` gives an existing type another name to make code clearer.
how do i use tuple in swift | tuple in swift explained => A tuple groups values: `let point = (x: 3, y: 4)` then `point.x`. Functions can return tuples to give back several values.
how do i use inout in swift | inout in swift explained => An `inout` parameter lets a function change the caller's variable; call it with `&`, like `double(&score)`.
what does variadic do in swift | swift variadic | how do i use variadic in swift | variadic in swift explained => A variadic parameter like `func sum(_ numbers: Int...)` accepts any number of values as an array.
how do i use argument label in swift | argument label in swift explained => Swift parameters can have an outside label and an inside name, like `func move(to point: CGPoint)`. Use `_` to skip the label.
# tag: coding.swiftui.views
how do i use a image in swiftui | image view swiftui => In Swift, `Image("name")` shows a picture from your asset catalog, and `Image(systemName: "star.fill")` shows an SF Symbol. Add `.resizable()` to scale it.
how do i use a button in swiftui | button view swiftui => In Swift, `Button("Tap me") { score += 1 }` runs the closure when tapped. Use the label form to put any view inside.
how do i use a vstack in swiftui | vstack view swiftui => In Swift, `VStack { }` stacks views top to bottom. Give it `spacing:` and `alignment:` to control the layout.
how do i use a hstack in swiftui | hstack view swiftui => In Swift, `HStack { }` places views side by side, left to right.
how do i use a zstack in swiftui | zstack view swiftui => In Swift, `ZStack { }` layers views on top of each other, later ones in front, like a background behind text.
how do i use a spacer in swiftui | spacer view swiftui => In Swift, `Spacer()` is flexible empty space that pushes other views apart inside a stack.
how do i use a list in swiftui | list view swiftui => In Swift, `List(items) { item in Text(item.name) }` shows a scrolling list of rows. The items should be Identifiable.
swiftui for each | how do i use a for each in swiftui | foreach view swiftui => In Swift, `ForEach(items) { item in ... }` makes a view for each item inside a stack or list. Items need a stable id.
swiftui scroll view | how do i use a scroll view in swiftui | scrollview view swiftui => In Swift, `ScrollView { }` lets its content scroll. Use `ScrollView(.horizontal)` for sideways scrolling.
swiftui navigation stack | how do i use a navigation stack in swiftui | navigationstack view swiftui => In Swift, `NavigationStack { }` gives a navigation bar and lets `NavigationLink` push new screens. It replaces the older NavigationView.
swiftui navigation link | how do i use a navigation link in swiftui | navigationlink view swiftui => In Swift, `NavigationLink("Settings") { SettingsView() }` pushes a new screen when tapped, inside a NavigationStack.
swiftui tab view | how do i use a tab view in swiftui | tabview view swiftui => In Swift, `TabView { }` shows tabs at the bottom. Give each child `.tabItem { Label("Home", systemImage: "house") }`.
swiftui text field | how do i use a text field in swiftui | textfield view swiftui => In Swift, `TextField("Name", text: $name)` is an editable text box bound to a @State string with a dollar sign.
what is securefield in swiftui | swiftui secure field | how do i use a secure field in swiftui | securefield view swiftui => In Swift, `SecureField("Password", text: $password)` is a text field that hides what you type.
how do i use a toggle in swiftui | toggle view swiftui => In Swift, `Toggle("Sound", isOn: $soundOn)` is an on/off switch bound to a Bool.
how do i use a slider in swiftui | slider view swiftui => In Swift, `Slider(value: $volume, in: 0...1)` lets the user drag to pick a number in a range.
how do i use a stepper in swiftui | stepper view swiftui => In Swift, `Stepper("Lives: \(lives)", value: $lives, in: 1...5)` shows plus and minus buttons to change a number.
how do i use a picker in swiftui | picker view swiftui => In Swift, `Picker("Color", selection: $color) { }` lets the user choose one option. Tag each option with `.tag(value)`.
swiftui date picker | how do i use a date picker in swiftui | datepicker view swiftui => In Swift, `DatePicker("Birthday", selection: $date, displayedComponents: .date)` lets the user pick a date.
what is progressview in swiftui | swiftui progress view | how do i use a progress view in swiftui | progressview view swiftui => In Swift, `ProgressView()` shows a spinner, and `ProgressView(value: 0.5)` shows a progress bar half full.
how do i use a form in swiftui | form view swiftui => In Swift, `Form { }` groups controls in a settings-style layout. Use `Section` inside to split it up.
how do i use a section in swiftui | section view swiftui => In Swift, `Section("Account") { }` groups rows inside a List or Form with an optional header.
how do i use a label in swiftui | label view swiftui => In Swift, `Label("Favorites", systemImage: "heart")` shows an icon and text together.
how do i use a color in swiftui | color view swiftui => In Swift, `Color.blue` is a view that fills its space with color. Make custom ones with `Color(red: 1, green: 0.5, blue: 0)`.
what is rectangle in swiftui | swiftui rectangle | how do i use a rectangle in swiftui | rectangle view swiftui => In Swift, `Rectangle()`, `Circle()`, `Capsule()` and `RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12)` are shapes you can `.fill()` or `.stroke()`.
swiftui geometry reader | how do i use a geometry reader in swiftui | geometryreader view swiftui => In Swift, `GeometryReader { geo in }` gives you the size of the space a view has, through `geo.size`. Use it only when you really need sizes.
swiftui lazy vgrid | how do i use a lazy vgrid in swiftui | lazyvgrid view swiftui => In Swift, `LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.flexible()), GridItem(.flexible())]) { }` lays views out in a grid, creating them only as they appear.
what is lazyvstack in swiftui | swiftui lazy vstack | how do i use a lazy vstack in swiftui | lazyvstack view swiftui => In Swift, `LazyVStack` works like VStack inside a ScrollView but only creates rows as they come on screen, which is better for long lists.
how do i use a canvas in swiftui | canvas view swiftui => In Swift, `Canvas { context, size in }` lets you draw shapes and images directly, which is fast for many simple drawings like particles.
swiftui timeline view | how do i use a timeline view in swiftui | timelineview view swiftui => In Swift, `TimelineView(.animation) { context in }` redraws its content on a schedule, every frame with .animation, handy for clocks and simple games.
how do i use a menu in swiftui | menu view swiftui => In Swift, `Menu("Options") { Button("Delete") { } }` shows a button that opens a pop-up menu of actions.
what is sharelink in swiftui | swiftui share link | how do i use a share link in swiftui | sharelink view swiftui => In Swift, `ShareLink(item: url)` shows the system share sheet so users can send a link or text to other apps.
what is contentunavailableview in swiftui | swiftui content unavailable view | how do i use a content unavailable view in swiftui | contentunavailableview view swiftui => In Swift, `ContentUnavailableView("No Results", systemImage: "magnifyingglass")` (iOS 17) shows a friendly empty-state screen.
# tag: coding.swiftui.modifiers
swiftui padding modifier | how do i use .padding in swiftui => In Swift, `.padding()` adds space around a view; `.padding(.horizontal, 20)` adds it only on chosen sides.
swiftui frame modifier | how do i use .frame in swiftui => In Swift, `.frame(width: 100, height: 50)` sets a size, and `.frame(maxWidth: .infinity)` makes a view stretch to fill the width.
swiftui font modifier | how do i use .font in swiftui => In Swift, `.font(.title)` sets text style. Built-in styles include .largeTitle, .title, .headline, .body and .caption, and they scale with the user's text size.
what does foregroundstyle do in swiftui | swiftui foreground style modifier | how do i use .foregroundstyle in swiftui | foreground style swiftui => In Swift, `.foregroundStyle(.red)` sets the color of text and symbols. It replaces the older `.foregroundColor`.
swiftui background modifier | how do i use .background in swiftui => In Swift, `.background(.yellow)` puts a color or view behind a view. Order matters: add padding first to color the padded area.
swiftui corner radius modifier | how do i use .cornerradius in swiftui | corner radius swiftui => In Swift, `.clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 12))` rounds corners. The old `.cornerRadius()` modifier is deprecated.
what does clipshape do in swiftui | swiftui clip shape modifier | how do i use .clipshape in swiftui | clip shape swiftui => In Swift, `.clipShape(Circle())` cuts a view to a shape, like making a round profile picture.
swiftui shadow modifier | how do i use .shadow in swiftui => In Swift, `.shadow(radius: 5)` adds a soft shadow behind a view.
what does opacity do in swiftui | swiftui opacity modifier | how do i use .opacity in swiftui | opacity swiftui => In Swift, `.opacity(0.5)` makes a view half see-through. 0 is invisible and 1 is solid.
what does offset do in swiftui | swiftui offset modifier | how do i use .offset in swiftui | offset swiftui => In Swift, `.offset(x: 10, y: 0)` moves where a view is drawn without changing the layout around it.
what does rotationeffect do in swiftui | swiftui rotation effect modifier | how do i use .rotationeffect in swiftui | rotation effect swiftui => In Swift, `.rotationEffect(.degrees(45))` rotates a view.
what does scaleeffect do in swiftui | swiftui scale effect modifier | how do i use .scaleeffect in swiftui | scale effect swiftui => In Swift, `.scaleEffect(1.5)` draws a view bigger or smaller without changing its layout size.
what does ontapgesture do in swiftui | swiftui on tap gesture modifier | how do i use .ontapgesture in swiftui => In Swift, `.onTapGesture { }` runs code when the view is tapped. Use a Button instead for real buttons, for accessibility.
what does gesture do in swiftui | swiftui gesture modifier | how do i use .gesture in swiftui | gesture swiftui => In Swift, `.gesture(DragGesture().onChanged { value in })` adds a gesture like dragging, using `value.translation` to see how far it moved.
swiftui on appear modifier | how do i use .onappear in swiftui | on appear swiftui => In Swift, `.onAppear { }` runs when the view appears on screen, and `.onDisappear` when it leaves.
swiftui task modifier | how do i use .task in swiftui => In Swift, `.task { await load() }` starts async work when the view appears and cancels it automatically when the view goes away.
swiftui on change modifier | how do i use .onchange in swiftui | on change swiftui => In Swift, `.onChange(of: score) { oldValue, newValue in }` runs when a value changes (this two-parameter form is iOS 17 and later).
swiftui sheet modifier | how do i use .sheet in swiftui => In Swift, `.sheet(isPresented: $showSettings) { SettingsView() }` slides up a new screen when the Bool becomes true.
what does fullscreencover do in swiftui | swiftui full screen cover modifier | how do i use .fullscreencover in swiftui | full screen cover swiftui => In Swift, `.fullScreenCover(isPresented: $show) { }` shows a screen that covers everything, unlike a sheet.
swiftui alert modifier | how do i use .alert in swiftui => In Swift, `.alert("Game Over", isPresented: $showAlert) { Button("OK") { } }` shows a pop-up alert when the Bool is true.
what does confirmationdialog do in swiftui | swiftui confirmation dialog modifier | how do i use .confirmationdialog in swiftui | confirmation dialog swiftui => In Swift, `.confirmationDialog("Delete?", isPresented: $ask) { }` shows a set of choices, like an action sheet.
what does navigationtitle do in swiftui | swiftui navigation title modifier | how do i use .navigationtitle in swiftui | navigation title swiftui => In Swift, `.navigationTitle("Home")` sets the title at the top, on a view inside a NavigationStack.
swiftui toolbar modifier | how do i use .toolbar in swiftui => In Swift, `.toolbar { ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) { Button("Add") { } } }` puts buttons in the navigation bar.
what does disabled do in swiftui | swiftui disabled modifier | how do i use .disabled in swiftui | disabled swiftui => In Swift, `.disabled(true)` greys out a control so it cannot be used.
swiftui animation modifier | how do i use .animation in swiftui => In Swift, `.animation(.spring, value: isOn)` animates changes to a view whenever that value changes.
swiftui transition modifier | how do i use .transition in swiftui => In Swift, `.transition(.slide)` sets how a view animates in and out when it is added or removed inside withAnimation.
what does ignoressafearea do in swiftui | swiftui ignores safe area modifier | how do i use .ignoressafearea in swiftui | ignores safe area swiftui => In Swift, `.ignoresSafeArea()` lets a view, like a background color, extend under the notch and home indicator.
what does liststyle do in swiftui | swiftui list style modifier | how do i use .liststyle in swiftui | list style swiftui => In Swift, `.listStyle(.plain)` changes how a List looks; others include .insetGrouped and .sidebar.
swiftui button style modifier | how do i use .buttonstyle in swiftui => In Swift, `.buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)` gives a Button a filled, colored look. `.bordered` is a lighter version.
what does tint do in swiftui | swiftui tint modifier | how do i use .tint in swiftui | tint swiftui => In Swift, `.tint(.green)` sets the accent color for controls like buttons, toggles and sliders.
what does aspectratio do in swiftui | swiftui aspect ratio modifier | how do i use .aspectratio in swiftui | aspect ratio swiftui => In Swift, `.aspectRatio(contentMode: .fit)` scales a resizable image to fit without stretching; `.fill` fills the space and may crop.
what does overlay do in swiftui | swiftui overlay modifier | how do i use .overlay in swiftui | overlay swiftui => In Swift, `.overlay { }` draws another view on top of this one, like a badge on an icon.
what does multilinetextalignment do in swiftui | swiftui multiline text alignment modifier | how do i use .multilinetextalignment in swiftui | multiline text alignment swiftui => In Swift, `.multilineTextAlignment(.center)` centers text that wraps onto several lines.
swiftui line limit modifier | how do i use .linelimit in swiftui | line limit swiftui => In Swift, `.lineLimit(2)` limits text to 2 lines, adding ... if it is longer.
what does keyboardtype do in swiftui | swiftui keyboard type modifier | how do i use .keyboardtype in swiftui | keyboard type swiftui => In Swift, `.keyboardType(.numberPad)` shows a number keyboard for a TextField on iPhone and iPad.
what does onsubmit do in swiftui | swiftui on submit modifier | how do i use .onsubmit in swiftui | on submit swiftui => In Swift, `.onSubmit { }` runs when the user presses return in a TextField.
what does focused do in swiftui | swiftui focused modifier | how do i use .focused in swiftui | focused swiftui => In Swift, `.focused($isFocused)` with a `@FocusState` Bool lets you show or hide the keyboard for a field in code.
swiftui searchable modifier | how do i use .searchable in swiftui => In Swift, `.searchable(text: $query)` adds a search bar to a navigation view.
swiftui refreshable modifier | how do i use .refreshable in swiftui => In Swift, `.refreshable { await reload() }` adds pull-to-refresh to a List or ScrollView.
what does swipeactions do in swiftui | swiftui swipe actions modifier | how do i use .swipeactions in swiftui => In Swift, `.swipeActions { Button("Delete", role: .destructive) { } }` adds buttons that appear when a list row is swiped.
what does contextmenu do in swiftui | swiftui context menu modifier | how do i use .contextmenu in swiftui | context menu swiftui => In Swift, `.contextMenu { }` shows a menu when the user long-presses a view.
what does accessibilitylabel do in swiftui | swiftui accessibility label modifier | how do i use .accessibilitylabel in swiftui | accessibility label swiftui => In Swift, `.accessibilityLabel("Play button")` tells VoiceOver what a view is, important for icon-only buttons.
swiftui environment modifier | how do i use .environment in swiftui => In Swift, `.environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)` sets an environment value for a view and its children; `@Environment` reads one.
what does preferredcolorscheme do in swiftui | swiftui preferred color scheme modifier | how do i use .preferredcolorscheme in swiftui | preferred color scheme swiftui => In Swift, `.preferredColorScheme(.dark)` asks for dark mode for that view's presentation.
what does id do in swiftui | how do i use .id in swiftui | id swiftui => In Swift, `.id(value)` gives a view an identity; changing the value makes SwiftUI treat it as a brand new view, which resets its state.
# tag: coding.swiftui.state
what does state do in swift | state property wrapper => In Swift, `@State private var score = 0` stores a small piece of data owned by a view. When it changes, SwiftUI redraws the view.
what does binding do in swift | binding property wrapper => In Swift, `@Binding var isOn: Bool` lets a child view read and change a value owned by its parent, which passes it with `$isOn`.
what does observable do in swift | observable property wrapper => In Swift, `@Observable class Game { var score = 0 }` (iOS 17) makes a class whose property changes update any SwiftUI view that reads them. It replaces most ObservableObject use.
what does bindable do in swift | bindable property wrapper => In Swift, `@Bindable var game: Game` lets you make bindings like `$game.name` to an @Observable object's properties.
what does environment do in swift | environment property wrapper => In Swift, `@Environment(\.dismiss) var dismiss` reads a value from the environment; calling `dismiss()` closes a sheet or pops a screen.
what is @stateobject in swiftui | swiftui state object | what does state object do in swift | state object property wrapper => In Swift, `@StateObject` creates and owns an ObservableObject in a view (the pre-iOS 17 way). With @Observable you use @State instead.
swiftui observed object | what does observed object do in swift | observed object property wrapper => In Swift, `@ObservedObject` watches an ObservableObject passed in from outside. It is the older system; new code uses @Observable.
what does published do in swift | published property wrapper => In Swift, `@Published var score = 0` inside an ObservableObject announces changes so views update. New code uses @Observable instead.
swiftui app storage | what does app storage do in swift | app storage property wrapper => In Swift, `@AppStorage("highScore") var highScore = 0` saves a small value in UserDefaults and updates the view when it changes.
swiftui focus state | what does focus state do in swift | focus state property wrapper => In Swift, `@FocusState var isFocused: Bool` tracks which text field is focused, so you can move focus or hide the keyboard.
what does query do in swift | query property wrapper => In Swift, `@Query var items: [Item]` (SwiftData) fetches saved models and keeps the view updated as they change.
what is @mainactor in swiftui | swiftui main actor | what does main actor do in swift | main actor property wrapper => In Swift, `@MainActor` makes code run on the main thread, which is required for updating the UI.
# tag: coding.swift.frameworks
how do i use userdefaults in my app | userdefaults ios => In Swift, `UserDefaults.standard.set(10, forKey: "level")` saves small settings that survive app restarts; read back with `integer(forKey:)`. It is not for big data or secrets.
what is swiftdata in swift | swift swiftdata | how do i use swiftdata in my app | swiftdata ios => SwiftData (iOS 17) saves your own model objects to the device. Mark a class with `@Model`, add `.modelContainer(for: Item.self)` to the app, and fetch with @Query.
how do i use core data in my app | core data ios => Core Data is Apple's older framework for saving structured data on the device. SwiftData is the newer, simpler Swift-first option built on similar ideas.
what is urlsession in swift | swift urlsession | how do i use urlsession in my app | urlsession ios => In Swift, `let (data, _) = try await URLSession.shared.data(from: url)` downloads data from the internet using async/await.
how do i use codable in my app | codable ios => Making a struct `Codable` lets `JSONDecoder` and `JSONEncoder` turn it to and from JSON automatically when the property names match the keys.
how do i use jsondecoder in my app | jsondecoder ios => In Swift, `try JSONDecoder().decode(Player.self, from: data)` turns JSON data into a Codable Player struct, throwing if the shape does not match.
what is filemanager in swift | swift filemanager | how do i use filemanager in my app | filemanager ios => In Swift, `FileManager.default` works with files and folders, like finding the app's documents folder with `URL.documentsDirectory`.
what is timer in swift | swift timer | how do i use timer in my app | timer ios => In Swift, `Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 1, repeats: true) { _ in }` runs code every second. In SwiftUI, `.onReceive(Timer.publish(...).autoconnect())` or TimelineView also work.
how do i use dispatchqueue in my app | dispatchqueue ios => In Swift, `DispatchQueue.main.async { }` runs code on the main thread, and `asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2)` runs it after a delay. Swift concurrency with `Task` is the newer way.
how do i use task in my app | task ios => In Swift, `Task { await doWork() }` starts async work from regular code. `try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))` pauses without blocking.
what is spritekit in swift | swift spritekit | how do i use spritekit in my app | spritekit ios => SpriteKit is Apple's 2D game framework with sprites, physics, particles and actions. Show a scene in SwiftUI with `SpriteView(scene:)`.
what is scenekit in swift | swift scenekit | how do i use scenekit in my app | scenekit ios => SceneKit is Apple's older high-level 3D framework. RealityKit is the newer one, especially for AR and visionOS.
what is realitykit in swift | swift realitykit | how do i use realitykit in my app | realitykit ios => RealityKit is Apple's modern 3D and AR framework, used for AR apps on iPhone and iPad and for visionOS apps.
what is arkit in swift | swift arkit | how do i use arkit in my app | arkit ios => ARKit tracks the device's position and the world around it through the camera, so you can place virtual things in the real world.
what is avfoundation in swift | swift avfoundation | how do i use avfoundation in my app | avfoundation ios => AVFoundation plays and records audio and video. `AVAudioPlayer` is a simple way to play a sound file in a game.
what is gamekit in swift | swift gamekit | how do i use gamekit in my app | gamekit ios => GameKit connects your game to Game Center for leaderboards, achievements and multiplayer.
how do i use charts in my app | charts ios => Swift Charts (iOS 16) draws bar, line and other charts in SwiftUI with views like `BarMark` and `LineMark`.
what is mapkit in swift | swift mapkit | how do i use mapkit in my app | mapkit ios => MapKit shows maps. In SwiftUI, `Map()` shows an interactive map, and you can add markers and annotations.
what is core location in swift | swift core location | how do i use core location in my app | core location ios => Core Location gets the device's location through `CLLocationManager`, after the user gives permission.
what is photosui in swift | swift photosui | how do i use photosui in my app | photosui ios => In Swift, `PhotosPicker(selection: $item)` from PhotosUI lets users pick photos without giving your app access to their whole library.
what is coreml in swift | swift coreml | how do i use coreml in my app | coreml ios => Core ML runs machine learning models on the device, fast and private. Create ML can train simple models without much code.
what is widgetkit in swift | swift widgetkit | how do i use widgetkit in my app | widgetkit ios => WidgetKit makes home screen and lock screen widgets using SwiftUI views and a timeline of entries.
how do i use storekit in my app | storekit ios => StoreKit handles in-app purchases and subscriptions. StoreKit 2 uses async/await, like `try await product.purchase()`.
what is haptics in swift | swift haptics | how do i use haptics in my app | haptics ios => In Swift, `UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .medium).impactOccurred()` makes a vibration tap. In SwiftUI, `.sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: value)` (iOS 17) does it declaratively.
what is keychain in swift | swift keychain | how do i use keychain in my app | keychain ios => The Keychain securely stores small secrets like passwords and tokens. Never store them in UserDefaults.
what is uikit in swift | swift uikit | how do i use uikit in my app | uikit ios => UIKit is Apple's older UI framework using view controllers. SwiftUI is newer, but you can mix them with UIViewRepresentable and UIHostingController.
